description: This is a PHP source file defining a client class for interacting with the AWS Mainframe Modernization Application Testing service. It extends the AwsClient class and uses PHPDoc annotations to declare available methods for various testing operations.

classes.name: AwsAppTestClient
classes.description: A specialized AWS SDK client for the AWS Mainframe Modernization Application Testing service, providing methods for creating, deleting, retrieving, and managing test cases, configurations, suites, and runs.

methods.name: createTestCase
methods.description: Initiates the creation of a new test case within the testing service.

methods.name: createTestCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initiates the creation of a new test case.

methods.name: createTestConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new test configuration.

methods.name: createTestSuiteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new test suite.

methods.name: deleteTestCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a specified test case.

methods.name: getTestCase
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific test case.

methods.name: getTestCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a test case.

methods.name: getTestConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves details of a test configuration.

methods.name: getTestConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a test configuration.

methods.name: getTestRunStep
methods.description: Fetches a specific step of a test run.

methods.name: getTestRunStepAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a test run step.

methods.name: getTestSuite
methods.description: Retrieves information about a test suite.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: listTestRunSteps
methods.description: Lists steps in a test run.

methods.name: listTestRunTestCases
methods.description: Lists test cases associated with a test run.

methods.name: listTestRunTestCasesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists test cases in a test run.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
